name: Sera — a gate on a hill

start.speaker: sera
start.text: Awake? I was thinking about after. Whatever after is. There is a gate on a hill north of the purge line that nobody keeps any more. I would like to keep a gate with you.

choices.text: This has to end, Sera. I cannot carry it into what is coming.

after.speaker: sera
after.text: Then it is a plan. Sleep.

ended.speaker: sera
ended.text: Right. Clean break. I have had worse orders. The left is still yours; that was never about this.
